banner: On entering, choose one Magnum Opus to advance.

top.text:
While completed, at the start of the C.o.G. player's turn:

Discard an energy card from the deck. If it is a split energy card, pick one. Other player's rayguns CANNOT shoot with that energy.

Also resolve this effect on entering C.o.G..

middle.text:
While completed:

The discarded or picked energy above is now the ONLY energy that other player rayguns CAN shoot with.

bottom.text:
When completed, peace reigns across the galaxy. All are one. Forever.

The antiquarian responsible does not last long enough as an individual to regret this.

top.text:
While completed:

Players in C.o.G. take 1 less damage from all sources.

middle.text:
While completed:

Players in C.o.G. take 1 less damage (2 less total) from all sources.

bottom.text:
When completed, this device acquires all fusion energy from the galaxy. Stars blink out. The fire of the galaxy is extinguished.

The antiquarian responsible expresses exteremely brief surprise at the energy now present here.

top.text:
While completed and C.o.G. is occupied:

For players outside of C.o.G.:
* Draw and play 1 fewer energy.
* Play 1 energy from the deck at the start of their turn.

middle.text:
While completed:

The above effect is now 2 fewer energy cards and play 2 from the deck.

bottom.text:
When completed, this reality has merged permanently with the next. And the next. And the next.

The antiquarian responsible experiences everything, if only for a brief moment. And another. And another.
